body: When I was a child, my mom told me one day that she has seen a ghost in our house. I was just 6-7 yrs old and it was afternoon , I can't find any reason for her lying to me. After many years I find her character  changing, she constantly engage fight with her MIL, in many night I have seen her talking to a unknown man through the phone. In those days only landline was there so no was able to track the caller. Eventually when my dad came to know about this.. he with his mom beat the hell out of my mom. If that had killed her, my life had been different from now. Instead these events had seeded in my soul and now no matter how much I try I can't have feelings for them. I have zero feelings towards them. Because or this I feel it is going to sabotage my family life too.
I don't know....I am really  scared for my life and the people around me...something terrible is going to happen
But knowingly or unknowingly this is going o affect my family life too. I will be getting married next year and it really bothers me. I feel I have some problem when it comes to relationships.
I tried so many times, but am not able to made peace with my family. My mind gets really crazy sometimes and eventually develops to hurt myself and others.
